purpose: Turn the approved brief into exact spoken wording without weakening truth or voice.
hard_gates: Spoken wording must preserve truth, claim boundaries, confidentiality and canonical names.
soft_gates: The opening, mechanism, payoff and ending should be specific and speakable.

failure.fallback: Return a concise diagnosis and a stronger source-grounded rewrite for editorial review.

regression_cases: A stronger hook cannot introduce an unsupported factual claim.
Generic AI phrasing fails the voice and specificity quality bar.
